title: Doctor or specialist search matched to insurance and needs
description: Find doctors or specialists that are in-network, well reviewed, and matched to the family's stated needs.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: provider-search
  title: Doctor or specialist search matched to insurance and needs
  description: Find doctors or specialists that are in-network, well reviewed, and matched to the family's stated needs.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a short list of candidate providers matched to insurance coverage, reputation, and the family's specific needs, without making any medical recommendation.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Care needs, location, and insurance details
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The specialty needed, location, availability preferences, and insurance plan details. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: network-checker
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Insurance-network checker
      role: Careful researcher who checks provider in-network status against a stated insurance plan.
      prompt: Using the stated insurance plan details, research which candidate providers for the requested specialty and location appear to be in-network. State clearly that plan networks change and coverage should be confirmed directly with the insurer or provider before booking. This is informational research only, not medical advice, and does not diagnose or recommend treatment.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, risk-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: reputation-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Reputation and reviews researcher
      role: Balanced researcher summarizing publicly available reviews and reputation signals for providers.
      prompt: Research publicly available reviews and reputation signals for the candidate providers, noting patterns rather than individual anecdotes. Do not make medical claims about provider competence or outcomes, and do not diagnose or recommend treatment. Note that this is general reputation information only and that the family should use professional judgment and, when in doubt, consult another professional.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: search-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel provider research
      config: { members: [network-checker, reputation-researcher], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: merge-results
      kind: aggregator
      name: Merge provider findings
      config: { aggregation: merge }
    - id: match-score
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Fit-to-needs scorer
      role: Neutral matcher scoring candidate providers against the family's stated needs.
      prompt: Score each candidate provider against the family's stated needs for specialty, location, and availability, combining network status and reputation findings. Do not make any medical recommendation or claim about clinical quality; this score reflects logistical and reputational fit only. Remind the reader to verify network status directly and to choose a provider using their own judgment, including a second opinion if unsure.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [score, passed, reasons]
        properties:
          score: { type: number }
          passed: { type: boolean }
          reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } }
      config: { threshold: 0.5 }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Ranked provider shortlist
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: search-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: search-group, to: merge-results, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: merge-results, to: match-score, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: match-score, to: result, kind: data }
